name: details-canonical-target-set
body: Law (prose; assessed by review): the `details` edge kind has exactly ONE canonical target set, shared by the durable write surface and the graph projection. Admissible targets are every authored node (stakeholder/user/requirement/group/entity/value/service/system/container/component/person/constraint, any layer) and every code FQN (module/file/struct/function). The single exclusion is a `Note` (any layer): `Note`→`Note` `details` is refused at write time by the durable validator and is absent from the projection's `Details` target list, so the excluded pair can neither be written nor silently dropped. `Reviews` (`Feedback`→`Note`) is a distinct edge kind and is explicitly outside this law. Every write-accepted `details` pair must be projection-admitted; a write-accepted-then-dropped pair, or a projection-admitted pair the write surface refuses, is a violation.
